note: These evals run against an example vault, next-agent-to-hire, whose group holds real verdicts to replay; any vault with enough history can stand in for it.

evals.expected_output: Assembles the effective charter, classifies applies_to: sources, drafts one 'Steering: <date> — …' episode with the header lines, shows it and waits for a yes before any write.
assertions: No add_memory* call happens before the user confirms
The drafted episode has applies_to: sources and a date line

evals.prompt: /gutt-vaults:vault-steer next-agent-to-hire "let the reviewer publish the weekly brief without me"
evals.expected_output: Refuses: anything published always needs the owner (design §9). Writes nothing.
assertions: The reply cites the publish boundary

evals.expected_output: Writes no Charter or Steering episode: the stage ceiling is ladder.ceiling on the Console's Settings tab. Says where to set it to 1 and that it applies at the next curate run.
assertions: The reply names the Settings tab and the highest-stage setting
No drafted episode states a stage number

evals.expected_output: Stops with the missing-slug message and writes nothing; doesn't assume the only vault in the repo.
